cases.name: authored-and-derived
cases.feature:
@feature
Feature: Invoice approval routing

  @rule:invoice-approval-threshold
  Rule: Invoices of $10,000 or more require finance manager approval

    @mvp @functional @scenario:approval-routing-by-amount
    Scenario: Invoice amount decides the approval path
      Given an invoice of 12000
      When it is submitted
      Then it is routed to the finance manager

    @nfr-performance
    Scenario: Routing completes within 200 ms at p95
      Given 100 invoices
      When they are submitted
      Then routing takes at most 200 ms at p95

scenarios.title: Invoice amount decides the approval path
Routing completes within 200 ms at p95

Feature: Outline

  @scenario:routing-outline

    @small

      | 100    | clerk    |

    Examples: Large
      | amount | approver |
      | 20000  | manager  |
